_meta.title: Shop product-intent confirmation record
_meta.method: Each submitted link was opened with a direct HTTPS request on 2026-11-17. The final URL after redirect and the page <title> were recorded as observed values. Intended-ASIN fields were NOT filled: the requester has not stated an intended ASIN, and a redirect is not evidence of intent.
rules: intended_* fields are only filled from a requester statement plus an official Amazon listing check. None is filled in this build.
observed_* fields are what the submitted link resolved to on the check date. They are kept separate from intended_* and are never copied into them.
A submitted token is a short-link code. It is not an ASIN unless it is 10 characters (Creators API, ItemIdType=ASIN).
